name: Groovy Palette & Frames
description: Thirty more entries on the COLORS row -- Amiga Workbench, the C64 boot screen, a Virtual Boy, rainbow, fuchsia, vaporwave -- plus eight new borders for every text box and menu. Press A on OPTION -> COLORS and the menu lifts off the game: the palette name and nothing else, left and right to walk the list, previewed on the running game. USE ADVANCED rides the engine per-tile colorization instead of replacing it, so a palette recolours eighteen colours on screen rather than four.
